Витамин K2.about: Osteocalcin γ-carboxylation cofactor: lumbar BMD is higher in postmenopausal osteoporosis.
Витамин K2.caution: Vitamin K2 (menaquinone, MK-7). For osteoporosis in postmenopausal women: systematic reviews are available (36033779, 35711002). For fractures: mixed data (used as a treatment for osteoporosis in Japan). For vascular calcification: limited data. Dose: 45-180 mcg/day. Caution: warfarin (vitamin K antagonist). There is little data (only 5 abstracts).
Витамин K2.food_sources: Natto, cheeses, eggs, meat; fat-soluble - take with fats.
Витамин K2.guidelines: MA 2015–2022: with osteoporosis, BMD is higher; fractures RR 0.43–0.50 only after sensitive analysis; AEs are more common (RR 1.22–1.33).
Витамин K2.how_to_choose: Menaquinone MK-7 45–180 mcg/day with fat; do not start on warfarin; priority - osteoporosis.
mechs: Activates osteocalcin and MGP (Ca into bone, not into blood vessels)
BMD of the lower back and forearm is higher (WMD 2.17/1.57); without osteoporosis there is no effect
uc-OC and uc-OC/cOC are lower, total osteocalcin +26.5; fractures RR 0.43–0.50 only after sensitive analysis
Витамин K2.myths: “Bones for everyone” - without osteoporosis, BMD does not change. “Cleans blood vessels” - there is little data. “Blood is like warfarin” - on the contrary, it is contraindicated with it.
Витамин K2.name: Vitamin K2
Витамин K2.onset: Long-term effect: MIC and uc-OC change over distance; There is no quick “bone strengthening”.
Витамин K2.title: Vitamin K2
Витамин K2.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Витамин K2.who_needs: Postmenopausal women with osteoporosis or low BMD (often with vitamin D); Without osteoporosis there is no effect.
